name: hedgedoc
summary:
[HedgeDoc](https://hedgedoc.org/) gives you access to all your files wherever you are.

HedgeDoc is a real-time, multi-platform collaborative markdown note editor.  This means that you can write notes with other people on your desktop, tablet or even on the phone.  You can sign-in via multiple auth providers like Facebook, Twitter, GitHub and many more on the homepage.

ports.description: Web gui port (internal port also needs to be changed if accessing at port other than 80, 443 and 3000).

env.name: DB_PORT
env.description: Port to access mariadb database default is 3306

env.name: CMD_DOMAIN
env.description: The address the gui will be accessed at (ie. `192.168.1.1` or `hedgedoc.domain.com`).

env.name: CMD_URL_ADDPORT
env.description: Set to `true` if using a port other than `80` or `443`.

env.name: CMD_PROTOCOL_USESSL
env.description: Set to `true` if accessing over https via reverse proxy.

env.name: CMD_PORT
env.description: If you wish to access hedgedoc at a port different than 80, 443 or 3000, you need to set this to that port (ie. `CMD_PORT=5000`) and change the port mapping accordingly (5000:5000).

env.name: CMD_DB_DIALECT
env.description: This variable allows selecting a database engine (if DB_HOST not set up). Available options are: `mariadb`, `mysql`, `postgres`, `sqlite`.

docs.setup:
HedgeDoc web interface can be accessed `http://${IP}:3000/`, if you want to use a custom domain or anything besides port 3000 you will need to leverage their env settings for callbacks: (specifically for CMD_DOMAIN, CMD_PORT and CMD_URL_ADDPORT)

[Full list of HedgeDoc options](https://docs.hedgedoc.org/configuration/)

For convenience we provide a working example using Mariadb as a backend in this document.

To run behind a reverse proxy we have a [preconfigured config](https://github.com/linuxserver/reverse-proxy-confs/blob/master/hedgedoc.subdomain.conf.sample) using docker networking included in our [SWAG](https://github.com/linuxserver/docker-swag) image and you can read how to use this in the [Reverse Proxy Confs repository](https://github.com/linuxserver/reverse-proxy-confs/#how-to-use-these-reverse-proxy-configs)

changelog.text: Add missing icu-data-full to fix bug with TextDecoder and image uploads.
Allow using `CMD_DB_DIALECT` to set up the `CMD_DB_URL`.
Rebase to Alpine 3.18, deprecate armhf as per [https://www.linuxserver.io/armhf](https://www.linuxserver.io/armhf).
Rebase to Alpine 3.16, migrate to s6v3.
Use python3 to build node sqlite3.
Add optional var `CMD_PORT` that is needed for accessing at port other than 80, 443 and 3000.
Add optional var `CMD_PROTOCOL_USESSL` that is needed for reverse proxy.
Rebase to ubuntu focal. Update to node 16. Make sure uploads are persistent.
Remove symlinking some folders from config to /opt/hedgedoc/public.
